notes.title: 35 Years of Platforming Fun!
notes.content:
The 1st November 2021 marked[b] 35 years[/b] since the first appearance of our hero, Alex Kidd, on consoles. He's had many wonderful adventures over the last three and a half decades and it's been a true pleasure to bring Alex back with Alex Kidd in Miracle World DX.

The last update brought new features to the game including reworked controls so players have a choice of taking on Miracle World with classic retro controls or taking a more modern approach to the battle against evil Janken, and a level select feature so players can relive their favourite levels with ease!

To celebrate Alex's 35 years we've knocked [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1333470/Alex_Kidd_in_Miracle_World_DX/][b]35% off[/b][/url] Alex Kidd in Miracle World DX for a week!

Thank you to everyone who has joined Alex on his 35-year journey, and for joining us this year to revisit Miracle World in the modern-day!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oWyspwR.gif[/img]

notes.title: New Controls & Level Select Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are very happy to confirm that an update is now live and available for Alex Kidd in Miracle World DX!
We really appreciate all of the feedback that has gone into this update and, of course, the patience of the community whilst this was worked on.

[h1]What's new?[/h1]

[u][b]Assisted Controls Menu[/b][/u]

If you access the options menu from within the main title screen settings, you will see an option to access a new [b]Assist Menu[/b] (Alt key by default on PC). Within this menu, you will find some new [b]optional[/b] settings:
[list]
[*] Infinite Lives has now been relocated here.
[*] Reworked Controls - Turning this option on makes Alex feel more responsive, but removes Alex's sliding effect making some optional areas of the game unreachable when using this mode.
[*] Adjusted Collisions - Turning this option on reduces Akex's collision with enemies making it slightly less likely for him to die throughout the game.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016444/6f96af7214d25aea6ff1b956b8367b0a11d2cb0a.png[/img]

[u][b]Level Select[/b][/u]

We're very pleased to add this much-requested feature! Once you have finished the game you'll find this option available to use from the main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016444/f45736f49892c622ed014ab44295ee84828ce6a4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016444/1c0e6fdb4a22056da89cf9c02929522a8198ddaa.png[/img]

Additionally, there are a new number of bug fixes and quality of life improvements, including:
[list]
[*] Level Selection Feature (Unlocked after completing the game)
[*] Assist mode Feature
[*] Invincibility Balancing and fixes
[*] Acid waterfall drop rate slowed down
[*] Cane of flight Fixes
[*] Animation fixes
[*] Throwing capsule fix
[*] Soft Lock Fixes
[*] Parplin Second Fight fix
[*] Ladder Fixes
[*] Localisation fixes
[*] Gooseka Ball Bug fix
[*] Jan Ken Pon labels fixed
[*] Remapping issues fixed
[*] Level 17 Spikes fix
[*] Octopus tentacle issue Fixed
[*] Fire Enemy fix
[*] Audio fixes
[*] Alex facing wall fix
[/list]
As always, thanks for playing - we really appreciate it and hope these updates provide something extra to the Alex Kidd experience for you.

notes.title: Alex Kidd in Miracle World remake gets June release date
notes.content:
Alex Kidd in Miracle World DX, developer Jankenteam's remake of the much-loved Sega Master System classic, will be making its way to PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Switch on 24th June.

The original Alex Kidd debuted on the Master System three and a half decades ago, back in 1986 (apologies to those out there suddenly feeling very old), and charted the adventures of the titular martial artist as he set off to rescue King Thunder's son.

Those adventures manifested as a bright, breezy puzzle-platfomer (one which Eurogamer's Christian Donlan described as "f*cking great" to me earlier, if you're looking for some kind of quality gauge), and Jankenteam's remake will offer all that, plus more.

notes.title: Sega's Alex Kidd is getting a remake
notes.content:
Unloved Sega mascot - no, not that one - Alex Kidd is making a return via a fresh version of 1986 classic Alex Kidd in Miracle World.

An expanded remake, Alex Kidd in Miracle World DX will feature all of the original platformer and more - extra levels, new boss fights, and a boss rush mode.

A classic mode option will also be offered, so you can switch off the 2020s visuals and return to a blockier 1980s experience.

notes.title: Sega's forgotten mascot, Alex Kidd is returning with a remake
notes.content:
Back when Sonic was just a twinkle in Mrs. Tiggy-Winkle’s eye, Sega’s jumpy mascot was a squat lad named Alex Kidd. Then the 90s came roaring in with their rude ‘tude, the Mega Drive launched with controllers shaped like throwing weapons, and the little boy was just not cool enough. Poor lad. If you feel he was done a great injustice, you might be thrilled to hear that his greatest adventure is being remade as Alex Kidd In Miracle World DX. Announced today, it’s coming next year, and you can see it below right now.
